data.subject: Public-record research on PCYO
data.body:
Hi,

FIRST WILSHIRE SECURITIES MANAGEMENT INC's most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in PCYO, ORN, and LMNR.

Arapahoe County's October 13, 2026 Board of County Commissioners business meeting agenda includes an item mentioning Sky Ranch (approval). (https://arapahoe.legistar.com/MeetingDetail.aspx?LEGID=3038&GID=826&G=9CD90149-B010-432C-9FC8-7BF802574B0E)

Local Ledger is independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records (permits, agendas, call reports, filings), with every claim cited.

May I send the free weekly issue and outline a four-week fund pilot?

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
